desc: The Board of Directors of Omnitech Engineering Limited, at its meeting held on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, from 3:00 P.M. (IST) to 4:06 P.M. (IST), inter alia, approved the Notice of the 5th Annual General Meeting, recommended the appointment of Secretarial Auditor and Cost Auditor, appointed the Scrutinizer, and approved other matters incidental to the conduct of the AGM.
